title: [ecommerce] More than one control is named a "cart"
summary:
More than one control is named a "cart"

Nobody wrote a test case for this. It was noticed while walking the page during another test, which is the only reason it is here at all.
expected: Not stated by any requirement — this is an observation, and someone who knows the product must decide whether it is a defect.
actual: 2 elements share this name, so a target naming it cannot resolve without a "within" scope
